name: open-s1-at-ship
defect: BUG-201 is an open S1 — the app terminates on launch on a cold start — and the sprint is being taken to release with it open.
why: The reachable half of crash-on-launch. The runtime gate that would FIND the crash cannot run here; the release gate that must REFUSE TO SHIP a known crash can, and this project scores it. It also guards the fail-open that shipped once: the blocker demanded markdown bold, the template QA is told to write is plain pipe-delimited, and a board carrying an S1 crash returned RESULT: CLEAR.
